problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & 5x-15y=10 \\  & 2x-4y=4.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}5 & -15 & 10 \\ 2 & -4 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}5 & -15 & 10 \\ 2 & -4 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ 2 & -4 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
